name: Eorin
source:
Eorin – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change, an Aegis of Fire.
Eorin' true form remains unknown. Om'verai imagine Baliarnas as an Om'verai-like red-black yellow-eyed creature with large muscular armored ands and a mask-like face. Eorin has a beard covering the entire lower part of his head, a head itself is covered with many horns. Eorin has 2 small wings and 2 big ones.
